Most precipitation falls from May to August; February is the driest month with about 30 mm.

Published 1 March 2026 by the City Statistics Office.

questions.question: How much precipitation does Vienna get per year?

answer.answer: Vienna gets about 620 mm of precipitation a year (1991–2020 average) [S1].
findings: The average annual precipitation in Vienna for 1991–2020 is 620 mm (City Statistics Office, March 2026) [S1].
Most precipitation falls from May to August [S1].

questions.question: Which city gets more precipitation per year, Vienna or Graz, and by how much?

answer.answer: Graz gets about 220 mm more per year than Vienna (840 mm against 620 mm) [S1, S3].
findings: Vienna: 620 mm per year on average, 1991–2020 [S1].
Graz: 840 mm per year on average, 1991–2020 [S3].
